baseline.edgePolicy: follow latest minor behavior where safe

components.name: ConfigProvider
components.notes: Supports prefixCls, componentSize, and themeMode. Locale and direction are still pending.

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.notes: Delegates to @lolita-ui/theme and auto applies CSS variables. Nested theme scopes are not implemented yet.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Supports type, size, loading, danger, block, and disabled. Full shape enum is still pending.

components.name: Space
components.notes: Supports direction, size, wrap, align, and split. Compact mode is pending.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Supports v-model:value, defaultValue, size inheritance, disabled, allowClear, status, and change/focus/blur emits. Prefix/suffix and extended input variants are pending.

components.name: Form
components.notes: Supports model/rules validation, validate/resetFields, and form-level submit flow. Advanced layout and trigger strategies are pending.

components.name: FormItem
components.notes: Supports field name binding, dynamic re-registration, help/error rendering, child status linkage, and valuePropName='checked'. labelCol/wrapperCol and advanced layout controls are pending.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Supports single and multiple selection, local search, controlled searchValue, remote-search hooks via filterOption=false + search events, loading/notFoundContent states, keyboard navigation, and FormItem status linkage. Tags mode and virtualized remote data flows are pending.

components.name: Checkbox
components.notes: Supports checked/defaultChecked, indeterminate, disabled, status, and FormItem checked-linkage. CheckboxGroup is pending.

components.name: Radio
components.notes: Supports standalone checked/defaultChecked/value flow, disabled, name, and shared group selection. Radio button variants are pending.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.notes: Supports value/defaultValue, options, disabled, name, status, update:value/change, and controlled undefined no-selection states. More advanced composition patterns are pending.

components.name: Switch
components.notes: Supports checked/defaultChecked, disabled, status, role=switch semantics, and FormItem checked-linkage. Native checkbox submission semantics and checkedChildren/loading variants are pending.

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: Supports activeKey/defaultActiveKey, items mode, TabPane mode, destroyInactiveTabPane, keyboard navigation, and disabled-skip behavior. Mixing items with TabPane warns and prefers TabPane. Editable tabs, vertical mode, and overflow handling are pending.

components.name: TabPane
components.notes: Provides structured slot-based tab panels with tab, tabKey, and disabled support. Advanced pane lifecycle and richer header composition are pending.

components.name: Menu
components.notes: Supports single-level items, selectedKeys/defaultSelectedKeys, vertical/horizontal navigation, roving focus, and disabled skipping. SubMenu, multiple mode, and openKeys are pending.

components.name: Tooltip
components.notes: Supports open/defaultOpen, hover/focus trigger, four placements, disabled state, aria-describedby linkage, and teleported mounting. Click trigger, collision detection, and advanced overlay content are pending.

components.name: Popover
components.notes: Supports open/defaultOpen, click/hover trigger, title/content slots, outside-click close in click mode, and teleported mounting. Complex interactive content and advanced placement logic are pending.

components.name: Dropdown
components.notes: Supports menuItems, click/hover trigger, ArrowDown entry into the first enabled item, select-after-close flow, and teleported mounting. Custom overlay renderers and cascading menus are pending.

components.name: Modal
components.notes: Supports open/defaultOpen, closable, maskClosable, keyboard, destroyOnClose, width, teleported mounting, focus return, and body scroll lock. Custom footer, async confirm, and stack management are pending.

components.name: Drawer
components.notes: Supports open/defaultOpen, left/right placement, closable, maskClosable, keyboard, width, teleported mounting, focus return, and body scroll lock. Top/bottom placement, push behavior, and extra actions are pending.

components.name: Tag
components.notes: Supports semantic color, bordered, round, and default slot rendering. Closable tags, arbitrary custom colors, and icon affordances are pending.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Supports semantic statuses, text, dot mode, and slot-wrapped content. Numeric count badges and Ribbon are pending.

components.name: Avatar
components.notes: Supports src/alt, size inheritance, circle/square shape, fallbackText, and slot fallback. Error fallback flows and Avatar.Group are pending.

components.name: Pagination
components.notes: Supports controlled and uncontrolled current page, pageSize, total, disabled state, and previous/next plus numeric paging. Quick jumper, page-size changer, and compact/simple variants are pending.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Supports columns, dataSource, rowKey, loading, emptyText, bodyCell/empty slots, and built-in pagination linkage. Sorting, filtering, row selection, expandable rows, fixed columns, and virtual scrolling are pending.

components.name: List
components.notes: Supports dataSource, loading, emptyText, split, and renderItem/empty slots. Grid, loadMore, infinite scroll, and header/footer extensions are pending.

components.name: DatePicker
components.notes: Supports single-date selection, controlled/uncontrolled value flow, allowClear, format, disabled, openChange/change emits, and FormItem status linkage. RangePicker, showTime, and advanced calendar modes are pending.

components.name: Upload
components.notes: Supports controlled/uncontrolled fileList, beforeUpload, customRequest, maxCount, removal, disabled, and button-triggered upload lists. Drag upload, chunking, preview, and richer transport layers are pending.

components.name: Tree
components.notes: Supports single selection, expanded state control, disabled-node blocking, and basic keyboard navigation. Checkable, multi-select, async load, drag-and-drop, and virtualization are pending.

components.name: Cascader
components.notes: Supports column-based single-path selection, controlled/uncontrolled value flow, allowClear, disabled, openChange/change emits, and FormItem status linkage. Multi-select, search, and remote lazy loading are pending.

components.name: Transfer
components.notes: Supports dual-list transfer, controlled/uncontrolled targetKeys, selectedKeys synchronization, disabled items, and change emits. Search, pagination, tree/table transfer, and richer rendering APIs are pending.

components.name: ProSearchTable
components.notes: Supports text/select/date/cascader search schema, formValues/queryValues layering, duplicate-key blocking, LPagination, rowKey enforcement, action refresh control, and deterministic playground/browser-gate coverage. dateRange, inline edit, column pinning, and remote schema builders remain out of scope.
